Beneath the {wiki:Ghostland|Ghostlands} and the {wiki:Isle of the Kings|Isle of the Kings} hides the Queen of the Banshees, protected by seven seals. Cross the catacombs, solve the puzzles of each seal (flames, levers, blood, pearls), receive the kiss of {npc:The Queen Of The Banshees} and enter the final room to take {item:Boots of Haste}, {item:Giant Sword}, {item:Tower Shield}, {item:Stealth Ring}, {item:Stone Skin Amulet} and 100 platinum coins.
